ABOUT EKS LKW

In the business since 1990.
A team dedicated to Ford trucks.

Genuine and aftermarket parts for Ford Cargo, Ford F-MAX and the Ford heavy vehicle range. Long experience with parts and attention to every request.

Since 1990, working with the people who keep transport moving.

We have been in the vehicle parts business since 1990. Years of sourcing parts for many kinds of vehicles shape the way we work today: we listen to what the customer needs, identify the part and prepare a clear quote.

Our team is dedicated to Ford trucks. We focus on the whole range of Ford Trucks rigid trucks and tractor units, with hands-on knowledge of their parts and applications.

You don't need to know the original part number.

You have the chassis number but not the part number? Send us the truck's VIN and a description of the part. Our team can identify parts from the chassis number and the vehicle details. If you have an original part number, an alternative reference or a photo, add them to make the check easier.

Parts for Ford Trucks

Come to us for any part your Ford truck needs: engine and lubrication, clutch, gearbox and driveline, brakes, suspension, steering, electrics, cooling, cab, filters and accessories. For Ford Trucks we offer genuine and aftermarket options, depending on the application and your preference.

Sourcing within 12–48 hours

Most parts are sourced within 12–48 hours; the lead time is confirmed in the quote. The quote states availability, when the lead time starts and the shipping terms. Sourcing and delivery to your address are separate steps.

Parts professionals. Straight answers.

We combine long experience with careful handling of every Ford truck request. Before you confirm, we tell you the type of part, the sourcing options and the commercial terms. EKS LKW PIESE AUTO S.R.L. is an independent supplier; this site does not claim to be an authorised Ford dealer.

FordCargo.ro is the EKS LKW PIESE AUTO S.R.L. website dedicated to Ford trucks. The company has been in the vehicle parts business since 1990; here we focus on the whole Ford Trucks range.

Questions and answers

Can you identify a part without the original part number?

Yes. Send the VIN (chassis number) and a description of the part. The team checks the application and sends you a quote; automatic VIN search is not available online.

Do you supply genuine or aftermarket parts?

You can ask for both genuine and aftermarket parts.

Which models does this site cover?

FordCargo.ro is dedicated to Ford Cargo, Ford F-MAX and other Ford heavy vehicles. For other makes and machinery, see eurokolben.ro.

What is the lead time?

Most parts are sourced within 12–48 hours; the lead time is confirmed in the quote.

How do I send a photo of a part?

Send a photo of the part on WhatsApp to +40 733 357 357, with a short description and the part number if you know it.

How is the shipping cost set?

Shipping is normally paid by the customer. The cost, method and delivery time are confirmed before you order.

Looking for parts for other truck makes, construction machinery or heavy vehicles? See eurokolben.ro

See eurokolben.ro

Parts for the whole Ford Trucks range

We supply parts on request for the whole range of Ford Trucks rigid trucks and tractor units: Cargo, F-MAX, F-LINE and vehicles for haulage, construction and special applications. Depending on the part number, parts come from stock or are sourced for you; availability and lead time are confirmed in the quote.

Parts for bodies and mounted equipment

On request we can also source parts for equipment mounted on the truck: refuse compactors, water or fuel tanks, pumps and other bodies. The body is often made by a manufacturer other than Ford, so we identify the part by the equipment's make, model, serial number and documentation.
